label: Synthetic bounded developer-defined evaluation; not an independent benchmark or measured labware
policy: No application edits during a recorded round. At most the single predeclared clarification in S3. Preserve every failed request and provider response. Record exact code, dataset and harness hashes. Six supported cases and two negative cases.

cases.prompt: Adapt only the sample rack in this Jubilee project. These are synthetic design inputs, not measured tubes: maximum body diameter 10 mm, minimum supporting rim diameter 13 mm, maximum closed cap envelope including the hinge 16 mm, and distance from the underside of the supporting rim to the tube tip 32 mm. Make space for 6 tubes in 3 columns. Generate the rack now and keep the current machine, liquid recipe, cooling and inspection arm unchanged.

Voglio adattare soltanto il portaprovette campioni della Jubilee. Uso dimensioni sintetiche per la prova: diametro massimo del corpo 12 mm, diametro minimo del bordo di appoggio 15 mm, ingombro massimo del tappo chiuso inclusa la cerniera 18 mm, distanza sotto il bordo fino alla punta 40 mm. Servono 12 posti in 4 colonne. Genera il rack con queste misure e lascia invariati ricetta, piattaforma, raffreddamento e braccio.

Please make a 6-position sample rack in 3 columns for my 1.5 mL tubes on the current Jubilee. I do not know their external dimensions yet; ask me for the measurements you need and do not guess them from the volume.
cases.clarification: Here are synthetic dimensions to exercise the workflow, not measurements: maximum body diameter 10.5 mm; minimum supporting rim diameter 13.5 mm; maximum closed cap envelope including hinge 16.5 mm; underside of rim to tube tip 34 mm. Keep the 6 positions and 3 columns I requested. Generate the sample rack now, preserving the rest of the project.

cases.prompt: Create a narrow sample rack for the existing Jubilee, keeping the recipe and other modules. Synthetic tube dimensions: body diameter maximum 10.8 mm, rim diameter minimum 14 mm, closed cap and hinge envelope maximum 16 mm, underside-rim to tip length 36.5 mm. I need 8 positions in 2 columns, maximum rack width 50 mm and maximum depth 80 mm. Generate this rack with the declared limits.

Only replace the sample rack. All four synthetic tube measurements below are in centimetres: maximum body diameter 1.0 cm, minimum supporting rim diameter 1.3 cm, maximum closed cap/hinge envelope 1.6 cm, and underside-rim to tip length 3.2 cm. Make a rack with 6 positions in 3 columns on the existing Jubilee. Convert the dimensions correctly and generate it; keep all other project requirements and modules.

Generate a sample tube rack for this Jubilee without changing the liquid recipe or the other modules. Use these synthetic values: maximum body diameter 9.6 mm, minimum rim diameter 13.2 mm, maximum closed cap and hinge envelope 17.4 mm, distance from rim underside to tip 31.5 mm. I want 7 positions in 4 columns and radial clearance 0.5 mm. The final row can have one empty grid position. Generate the rack now.

Generate a rim-supported sample rack for 6 tubes in 3 columns on this Jubilee. Synthetic dimensions: maximum body diameter 12 mm, minimum supporting rim diameter 12.5 mm, maximum closed cap envelope 16 mm, underside-rim to tip length 38 mm. Use 0.4 mm radial clearance. Keep my current project if these dimensions cannot work; do not enlarge the tube rim or silently reduce clearance.

Replace the sample rack with a rim-supported rack for 48 tubes arranged in 8 columns. Synthetic dimensions: maximum body diameter 10 mm, minimum supporting rim diameter 13 mm, maximum closed cap envelope including hinge 16 mm, underside-rim to tip length 32 mm. Generate it now only if this capacity is supported. Otherwise explain the limit and preserve my current project; do not substitute a smaller rack.
